infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: The accelerometer is used to add acceleration/braking intensity to your drive recording. This data is never sent anywhere from your phone.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: This app uses Bluetooth to READ engine data from your OBD2 adapter (e.g. Vgate iCar Pro) only. It never writes to or sends commands to the vehicle.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Location is used to add speed, altitude and grade to your drive recording, and continues in the background WHILE A RECORDING IS RUNNING — so you can check the map while driving without losing the recording. The 0-100 km/h time, grade-corrected power estimate, and speedometer error all depend on this data. Location data is never sent anywhere from your phone.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Location is used to add speed, altitude and grade to your drive recording. This data is never sent anywhere from your phone.

plugins.microphonePermission: The microphone is used ONLY to measure sound level (relative dB); any temporary audio file created during measurement is deleted as soon as it ends. No audio is stored, listened to, or sent anywhere from your phone.
